status: BLOCKED, catalog_only. TWO independent hazards, kept separate. (1) TOOLING: the structural enumeration that underpins identifiability, design-alias and the absorption tests assumes a DAG over the free variables and cannot evaluate this at all. The BIOLOGY IS NOT IN DOUBT (Matsumoto 2008, alpha5beta1, IGF-independent); the implementation is.
